subject: Recommend passwordless users for mTLS certificate-based authentication (#3311)
reason: The change modifies only a Tcl test file (tests/unit/tls.tcl) and documentation comments in valkey.conf, rewording the tls-auth-clients-user docs to recommend passwordless users for mTLS certificate authentication. No server code, command behavior, config semantics, or protocol handling changes, so there is no runtime behavior to test.
